snippet.title: Why It Works
snippet.description:
Modern life makes no sense - and somebody is definitely profiting from it.
We find out who. For fun.

Why It Works explains money, the internet, business, and why people are Like That - in short, funny videos. Why is everything pricier AND worse?
Why does the internet reward confidence over facts? Why are you tired and broke with nothing to show for it?

Simple English. Dry jokes. One question per video. No lectures, no buzzwords, no fake wisdom.
Plus a small cartoon guy who suffers through all of it so you don't have to.

New videos whenever the world does something dumb enough to explain. So, constantly.

Subscribe. It's free - we checked twice.
